name: moacyr-skills
description: Moacyr Ricardo's personal Claude Code plugins — custom skills, agents, and commands.

plugins.name: spec-workflow
plugins.description: Spec-driven development: a numbered specs/ catalog plus commands and agents that drive a decision from todo → doing → an open PR, with Linear and live-app verification wired in. Depends on live-verify.

plugins.name: live-verify
plugins.description: Prove a feature works against a running app: start the dev server, then drive it (browser or curl) to capture a screenshot/gif/text verdict. Reusable, no spec/tracker coupling.

plugins.name: utils
plugins.description: General-purpose standalone helpers (catch-all/playground). Currently: stacked-merge — squash-merge a PR or a chain of stacked PRs into main with the rebase bookkeeping handled.

plugins.name: rich-html
plugins.description: Turn your work into rich, self-contained interactive HTML deliverables: report synthesizes heterogeneous sources into a readable document; decide aggregates pending decisions into an expandable-context surface that emits one prompt to execute them. General-purpose, no spec/tracker coupling.

plugins.name: prototype
plugins.description: Turn a half-formed UI/flow idea into a faithful, clickable HTML mock in the target product's own look. mockup clones the real status-quo page and applies only the requested change (composing from the design system for net-new surfaces), declares its fidelity basis in a toggleable overlay, and emits one self-contained file. General-purpose, no spec/tracker coupling.
